methodology: Only committed git blobs between fixed source commits; later uncommitted work excluded. All changed files except finalaudit.md and docs/final-audit/** are included.
Source SHA256 covers exact committed bytes, not working-tree newline conversion.
Top-level exported function, value, type, class and re-export boundaries parsed with installed TypeScript; source discovery is not workflow verification.
Environment names only, parsed from static process.env access; addedEnvironmentNames are newly referenced per changed file, not a claim of new deployment requirements. No secret values.
Jobs are statically read from committed dispatcher SCHEDULES and Vercel crons. Existing master identities are copied from the source commit, matching exact or semicolon-separated source paths.
